edits.before: Trade autos behind the roar sustain — the cow chips politely until level 2 changes religions.
edits.after: Tahm's long-range Tongue Lash outranges you, and once stacked it stuns your engage cold.

edits.before: Full kit: headbutt-pulverize the carry off any wave state; trample the disengage.
edits.after: By 3 your engage takes over — his kit saves allies rather than trades back.

edits.before: Zone with combo threat — their carry farms at the range your W defines.
edits.after: Every landed WQ goes unanswered now — he has no way to trade back.

edits.before: Unbreakable Will online — tower dives become appointments; the cow ignores the counter-CC.
edits.after: Unbreakable Will survives the all-in while his ult is only a roam tool, not lane damage.

edits.before: First item: the front line holds and the combos chain into jungler arrivals.
edits.after: First item: your combo bursts through Thick Skin — force it while Devour is down.

edits.before: Late Alistar opens and survives: combo the carry, ult the focus, and trample the cleanup.
edits.after: Late you stay ahead by out-sequencing his W Devour save on your locked-on target.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His re-engage and his escape — all-in only while it is down. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Unbreakable Will banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Tahm Kench's Abyssal Dive (W) is down 21s at rank 1, 17s at rank 5 — his re-engage and his escape; all-in only while it is down. - Keep R Unbreakable Will banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Let him engage first, bait his chain empty, then flash-WQ onto his exposed carry after Abyssal Dive is spent.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Popping Unbreakable Will before he commits Abyssal Dive wastes your only answer to his all-in.
